lesson_card.plain_english: who can approve, access, trigger, delete, escalate, or spend when an AI agent starts acting
lesson_card.big_question: Is the product the agent, or the power to decide what the agent is allowed to do?
lesson_card.simple_analogy: the remote control for what an AI agent is allowed to touch, approve, buy, or break
lesson_card.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson_card.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand permission layer well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson_card.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson_card.episode_spine: California enacts new worker protections targeting AI-driven layoffs and surveillance is really about who controls what agents are allowed to do.
